description: This file contains the implementation of GPIO driver functions for the ESP32 platform within Zephyr RTOS, including configuration, interrupt handling, and callback management.

methods.name: rtc_gpio_is_valid_gpio
methods.description: Checks if a given GPIO number is valid for RTC use based on SOC support.

methods.name: gpio_pin_is_valid
methods.description: Checks if a GPIO pin number is valid based on SOC GPIO mask.

methods.name: gpio_pin_is_output_capable
methods.description: Checks if a GPIO pin can be configured as output.

methods.name: gpio_esp32_config
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin with specified flags (pull-up, pull-down, output, input, drive strength).

methods.name: gpio_esp32_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw input values from GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_esp32_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets multiple GPIO pins on the port based on mask and value.

methods.name: convert_int_type
methods.description: Converts GPIO interrupt mode and trigger to hardware-specific interrupt type.

methods.name: gpio_esp32_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt type for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: gpio_esp32_get_pending_int
methods.description: Retrieves pending interrupt status for GPIO port.

methods.name: gpio_esp32_fire_callbacks
methods.description: Fires registered callbacks for active GPIO interrupts.

methods.name: gpio_esp32_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for GPIO, calls callback firing functions.
